parameters.name: IpVersion
parameters.description:
The IP version of the asset that is protected by Cloud Firewall. Valid values:

- **4** (default): IPv4

- **6**: IPv6

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the response message.

Valid values:

- **zh** (default): Chinese

- **en**: English

parameters.name: SourceIp
parameters.description: The source IP address of the visitor.
